rough: add a light/dark theme toggle to the cockpit dashboard
old:
Add a light/dark theme toggle to the cockpit dashboard. Users should be able to switch between light and dark mode from a visible control on the dashboard. Keep the chosen theme across page reloads, and start with the system's color scheme preference if no choice has been saved yet. Use the project's existing styling approach for the colors, and check that text and key UI elements stay readable in both themes. [Location of the cockpit dashboard code, e.g. file or folder path]. Done when the toggle switches every dashboard view between light and dark, the choice persists after a reload, and the existing tests still pass (or any new tests I add pass).

What I added:

- Persist choice across page reloads

- Readable text and UI in both themes

The existing dashboard features should still work in both themes, and the existing tests should still pass.
